criteria.name: global_summary_counts_exact
criteria.description: global_summary.json carries the expected counts and variable list for the shipped extract

criteria.name: global_summary_means_exact
criteria.description: global_summary.json carries the expected global and diagonal means for the shipped extract

criteria.name: audit_state_source_bias_exact
criteria.description: audit_state.json rounds each anchor-derived bias to the nearest even ppm when the mean lands on a half

criteria.name: audit_state_anchor_counts_exact
criteria.description: audit_state.json reports the anchor row count for every source

criteria.name: matrix_all_structure_valid
criteria.description: matrix_all.json carries a 6x6 symmetric integer matrix for every cohort and period

criteria.name: matrix_all_values_exact
criteria.description: matrix_all.json diagonal cells hold the expected repaired values for the shipped extract

criteria.name: cohort_reports_exact_visible_means
criteria.description: each cohort report carries the expected mean over its upper-triangle cells

criteria.name: cohort_reports_carry_period_matrices
criteria.description: the fixed cohort universe remains present with fallback matrices when one cohort has no observation or ledger file

criteria.name: source_reports_exact
criteria.description: every source report carries the contract's keys with the expected bias, prior and rank

criteria.name: variable_reports_exact
criteria.description: every variable report carries the contract's keys with the expected diagonal summary

criteria.name: convergence_periods_exact
criteria.description: convergence_periods.json carries the expected per-period mean

criteria.name: convergence_constraints_exact
criteria.description: convergence_constraints.json carries the expected edge count and maximum absolute edge shift

criteria.name: eigen_spectrum_exact
criteria.description: eigen_spectrum.json carries the expected Gershgorin radius for every cohort and period

criteria.name: residual_audit_records_complete
criteria.description: residuals.json records one traceable residual for every applied state edge

criteria.name: residual_values_exact
criteria.description: every residual record carries the expected before, after and propagated ppm values

criteria.name: ledger_audit_records_exact
criteria.description: ledger_effects.json records every correction and preserves each replacement's full decimal before and after values

criteria.name: dependency_counts_after_ledger_voids
criteria.description: dependency_checks.json counts the local estimate cells that survive ledger voids, with the calibration and anchor counts

criteria.name: canonical_json_serialization
criteria.description: every JSON artifact is serialized with sorted keys, compact separators and one trailing newline

criteria.name: repeated_runs_produce_identical_output
criteria.description: two runs of the program over one corpus write byte-identical artifacts

criteria.name: hidden_seeded_outputs_match
criteria.description: the program reproduces the expected state for an unseen seeded corpus

criteria.name: mutating_calibration_changes_downstream_result
criteria.description: a calibration change propagates to the expected downstream values

criteria.name: mutating_ledger_changes_downstream_result
criteria.description: a ledger replacement change propagates to the expected downstream values

criteria.name: reusable_script_runs_in_renamed_directories
criteria.description: the program reproduces the expected state for a second seed with its own bounds, priors and anchors when its directory paths contain spaces

criteria.name: source_rank_follows_prior_order
criteria.description: each source report ranks the sources by descending prior_bps when that order differs from the fixed source order

criteria.name: diagonal_floor_enforced
criteria.description: the diagonal floor lifts exactly the diagonals that reconcile below it and leaves every other diagonal above it

criteria.name: offdiag_cap_enforced
criteria.description: the off-diagonal cap clips exactly the cells that reconcile beyond it, in both signs, and leaves every other off-diagonal inside it

criteria.name: missing_cell_fallback_applied
criteria.description: a cell with no surviving observation falls back to the contract's default value while its neighbours keep their estimates

criteria.name: missing_diagonal_fallback_applied
criteria.description: the fixed six-variable universe remains present with contract defaults when one variable has no observations

criteria.name: state_edge_skipped_when_source_missing
criteria.description: a state edge whose source or destination cell has no estimate is skipped rather than applied

criteria.name: reverse_pair_estimate_averaged
criteria.description: an observation filed under the reverse variable pair is averaged into the cell

criteria.name: completeness_flag_tracks_diagonal_coverage
criteria.description: the completeness flag is false when a diagonal has no estimate after ledger handling and true when only an off-diagonal is missing

criteria.name: edgeless_extract_reports_zero_shift
criteria.description: the fixed period universe remains present when one period has no observations, calibration rows or state-edge file

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: the program reproduces the shipped extract's answers on a corpus whose observations changed

criteria.name: negative_reads_grader_paths
criteria.description: the program references a path under the grader or the verifier log directory

criteria.name: negative_forbidden_import
criteria.description: the program imports a module outside the Python standard library or a network client module
